verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an AI inference cloud, and such a platform could plausibly offer scheduled or autonomous background jobs, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only per-request inference, a flex tier suited to 'asynchronous workloads', and rentable GPU clusters where users can 'run whatever you want'. These are a lower-priority service tier and user-side building blocks, not a product feature for setting up autonomous automations or recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
